        start
Idle ─────────────► Running ──stop──► (produces TimeEntry, back to Idle)
                       │  ▲
                 pause │  │ resume
                       ▼  │
                     Paused ──stop──► (produces TimeEntry, back to Idle)
```

`TimerState = NoTimer | ActiveTimer of ActiveTimer`, `ActiveTimer.Status:
TimerRunning | TimerPaused`, `Segments: TimerSegment list` (each with a
`Start` and optional open `End`). Legal transitions only: `start` requires
`NoTimer`; `pause` requires `TimerRunning` (closes the open segment);
`resume` requires `TimerPaused` (opens a new segment); `stop` requires
either status (closes any open segment, then completes).
